page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; epitaph verse in italic lines, then a rule, then a centred title block and a dedicatory paragraph with a drop-cap initial; page signature "H 3" at lower right of the text. No margin notes.

p.i: Ast ego sic pulsum(pia dixerit Anglia)soui,
Fallor ego, totus terrena facis an expers,

main_text.head: IOANNIS OECOLAMPADII, Basiliensis Ecclesiæ beati instauratoris, summæ tum doctrinæ, tum pietatis viri, Memoriæ.
main_text.p: OE Colampadius serena nuper Lampas, ade sacra Dei coruscans, Qualis limpidiore, puriore, Vix sullis micuit lucerna seclis, En mortis iacet obrutus tenebris: At sobis male sit mala tenebra Lucis munere qua breui sruentes, Eheu, nos miseros hominunciones Nocte sic premitis tenebricosa.
Sed bene hoc cecidit, nigra o tenebra, Quod dum ipsam petitis, malæ, lucernam, Laternam tamen obruistis snam: Laterna sut lateat quidem hic sepulta, Ipsa sed magis emicet lucerna.

page.notes: Verse lines are set as printed with some words in italic; the first stanza's line-breaks and the dedication's ligatures are approximated. Several words in the Latin verse are doubtful (e.g. "sobis", "hominunciones", "snam") and should be checked against the scan. The mid-page decorative rule and the faint marks at the edges are not transcribed.
